annotation.bound_parties_text: The section binds law enforcement agencies (and their chief officers) using unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as the commissioner of public safety, judges and the state court administrator for reporting duties.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: a law enforcement agency must not use a UAV without a search warrant issued under this chapter.
annotation.dates_quote: History: 2020 c 82 s 5; 2025 c 35 art 5 s 23
